messages:
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Heads up, new senior infra hire (backend infra) starts Mon. Want a tight 'first 5-day sprint' + clear 30/60/90 outcomes I can share with the team — anyone have a slim manager-facing template?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! We do. Dropping a compact playbook you can paste into the offer thread / onboarding doc. Short and manager-focused.
Priya (People Ops): ```Day 0 (preboard)
- Confirm laptop & VPN access, org directory, badges
- Create GitHub + infra repo access, PagerDuty, GCP project perms
- New hire profile in Handbook + connection list (skip-levels / mentors)

Day 1
- 9:00 intro with manager (role expectations, org map)
- 10:00 1:1 with buddy + quick infra tour (systems & dashboards)
- 1:1 with Eng Manager for goals, 1-on-1 cadence, and immediate priorities
- End-of-day: 30-min sync to answer questions + set 1st-week micro-goal

Week 1 (deliverables)
- Shadow on-call handover + write one short runbook PR
- Complete access checklist + invite to recurring team rituals
- Deliver a 30-min 'what I worked on' at week-close

30/60/90 outcomes (manager cheat-sheet)
- 30d: Understand codebase & infra ownership; complete 2 small PRs and one runbook; active in team channels
- 60d: Drive a small feature/incident remediation end-to-end; lead one retro; propose an optimization with cost/latency impact
- 90d: Own a service or infra surface, deliver measurable improvement (latency, cost, reliability), mentor a peer
```
Casey (IT Support): @Jordan I can pre-provision the laptop & cloud roles on Friday if you share job code + office assignment. I’ll also calendar the badge pickup. :white_check_mark:
Samir (Eng Manager): Also recommend a "first-task" that's meaningful but scoped: e.g., a config cleanup or short perf experiment. Suggest pairing schedule with two senior ICs in week1.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Can we add a line about autonomy expectations by day 90? A 1-sentence manager prompt to set clarity for the hire and stakeholders.
Priya (People Ops): Added a one-liner managers can use: "By day 90, the expectation is independent ownership of a core infra surface with clear success metrics (uptime, latency, cost or throughput)." Feel free to edit for role specifics.
onboard-bot: new-hire-form submitted for Jordan's candidate — welcome packet queued and first-week calendar template attached.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Perfect. I'll paste this into the offer acceptance thread and share with the hiring panel. Can you also PR this into the Manager Handbook?
Priya (People Ops): Will do — PR created: https://go.redwood/handbook/manager-onboard (mock link) — tagging @Samir for technical check.
Samir (Eng Manager): Reviewed. One tiny tweak: change "two senior ICs" to "two domain SMEs" so it maps to support rotations. :+1:
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Awesome, thanks team. I'll confirm with Casey about asset tag and share the first-week micro-goal in the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
